execution: Two fresh-context investigators read the same fictional packet independently. Each then cross-reviewed the other frozen record in a follow-up turn. A third fresh-context agent synthesized the packet and all four records. A fourth fresh-context agent repeats synthesis after one handoff-boundary clarification.
assessment: Skill-author assessment; unblinded, no independent scoring agent.
isolation: Investigators received no parent history, expected verdict, rubric or sibling report until reciprocal review. File access limits were prompt instructions, not a filesystem sandbox.
runtime: Exact model and sampling configuration not recorded. Agents inherited the session configuration.
versions: Initial investigation used the saved initial skill snapshot. Following the user-specified external repository comparison, three paragraphs were added covering question-method fit, conditional differences, and writer handoff. Cross-review and synthesis used the integrated version. These additions were not a test-driven bug fix; no before/after effect is claimed. The first synthesis retained a project-readiness question in manuscript prose. One sentence was added to the integrated reference before the fresh synthesis regression; all earlier versions and outputs are preserved.
scope: No live literature retrieval, bibliographic authenticity verification, source editing, or rendered manuscript validation. The live GitHub inspection informed skill development only.
available_vs_read: Four skill folders were frozen as available materials. Initial investigators reported reading research-manuscript-writing, literature-to-story and section-reasoning. Cross-review read the integrated literature-to-story guidance. Final synthesis reported reads will be appended. Other entrypoints receive consistency/package checks unless listed as read.

source_comparison.integration: General workflow ideas compared; original instructions written for this library, no upstream prompt/code/template files distributed.

path_resolution: Cases, runs and tested-skills paths are relative to the evaluation directory. Paths beginning skills/ are repository-relative.
